title: advertiser_ablation.v1
description: The advertiser each ad lands in when the clustering runs with one key kind dropped (or photos added as a key). Written by derive-advertisers to derived/advertisers_ablation.jsonl; the real clusters (advertiser.v1) are unchanged.

advertiser_id.description: a hash of the cluster's ad set: equal to the baseline id means the same cluster

link_kinds.description: the kinds that linked this cluster under the variant
